lesson.subject: general-knowledge
lesson.title: Hot and Cold Places
lesson.summary: Find the Equator and the Poles, and compare hot deserts and rainforests with the cold Arctic and Antarctic.
learning_objectives: Locate the Equator and the Poles
Describe a hot place and a cold place

standards.text: Identify the location of hot and cold areas of the world in relation to the Equator and the North and South Poles

success_criteria: I can say where the Equator and the Poles are
I can describe a hot place and a cold place
I can match animals to their places
lesson.real_life: The Thar and Cholistan deserts in Pakistan, the glaciers near K2 and the cold of Gilgit-Baltistan, and British moors compared with the Arctic.

blocks.markdown: Today's big question: where are the hot and cold places?
blocks.say: Today we travel to the hottest and coldest places on Earth.

blocks.alt: Rolling orange sand dunes under a clear blue sky
blocks.caption: Sand dunes in a hot desert. Deserts get very little rain.
blocks.credit: Photo by Emma Van Sant on Unsplash
blocks.say: This is a hot desert. Sand dunes roll for miles, with almost no rain.

blocks.markdown: The **Equator** is an imaginary line round the middle of the Earth.
blocks.say: The Equator is an imaginary line round the middle of the Earth.

blocks.markdown: The **tropics** are the hot places near the Equator.
blocks.say: Places near the Equator are hot. The Sun shines strongly there.

blocks.say: A hot desert is dry. It gets very little rain.

blocks.title: Omar's journey to the cold
blocks.transcript: Omar starts in the Thar desert in Pakistan. He packs a hat and plenty of water. He flies over the Equator. It is hot there. He sees a hot, wet rainforest below. Then he reaches the cold Arctic. He wears a thick coat, boots and gloves. He spots a polar bear on the ice. Omar learns to pack for the place.
blocks.caption: Omar travels from the Thar desert to the Arctic in one story and finds what he must pack.

points: The Equator is round the middle
blocks.say: Let us remember. The Equator is a hot line. Rainforests are wet and deserts are dry.

blocks.text: Stop 1: North Pole and South Pole

blocks.markdown: The **Poles** are the coldest places on Earth.
blocks.say: The North Pole is at the very top of the Earth. The South Pole is at the very bottom.

scenes.caption: North Pole.
scenes.say: The North Pole is at the top. It is in the Arctic.

scenes.caption: South Pole.
scenes.say: The South Pole is at the bottom. It is in Antarctica.

scenes.caption: Weak Sun.
scenes.say: It is very cold at both Poles because the Sun is weak there.

question.prompt: Which Pole is at the very top of the Earth?
question.explanation: The North Pole is at the top.

blocks.alt: A huge white iceberg floating in calm dark water under a cloudy sky
blocks.caption: A huge iceberg floating in cold polar water.
blocks.credit: Photo by Annie Spratt on Unsplash
blocks.say: Polar bears live in the Arctic. Penguins live in Antarctica.

scenes.caption: Penguin.

scenes.caption: Never meet.
scenes.say: They never meet, because they live at different Poles.
